title: 12.12: The Day

ai_content.desc_en: In 12.12: The Day, we see the world turn into a place of terror, where events unfold with everything sacred. In this thrilling drama, we see the opposing forces clash in a battle of life or death, while we see the heroes fight for survival. We will see how events unfold with everything sacred in this thrilling drama.
